example_uz: Josus o'z haqiqiy shaxsini yashirish uchun taxallus bilan ishlagan.

definition_en: A book or software that lists words with similar or related meanings.
example_en: Use a thesaurus to find more interesting words for your essay.
example_uz: Inshongiz uchun qiziqarliroq so'zlar topish uchun sinonimlar lug'atidan foydalaning.

definition_en: Happening to one person or thing separately, rather than as a group.
example_en: The teacher checked the homework of every student individually today.
example_uz: Bugun o'qituvchi har bir o'quvchining uy vazifasini alohida tekshirib chiqdi.

definition_en: The place where a war or a large fight takes place.
example_en: Many soldiers lost their lives on the battlefield during the war.
example_uz: Urush paytida ko'plab askarlar jang maydonida halok bo'ldi.

definition_en: Used to emphasize that what you are saying is true, even if surprising.
example_en: It was literally the most exciting thing that ever happened to me.
example_uz: Bu rostdan ham hayotimda sodir bo'lgan eng hayajonli voqea edi.

definition_en: More recent or recently made than the previous version.
example_en: I bought a newer model of this phone last week.
example_uz: Men o'tgan haftada bu telefonning yangiroq modelini sotib oldim.

definition_en: Relating to things that do not cause damage to the natural world.
example_en: We should buy more ecological products to help save the planet.
example_uz: Sayyoramizni asrash uchun tabiatga zarar yetkazmaydigan mahsulotlar xarid qilishimiz kerak.

definition_en: Dried parts of plants used to add flavor to food.
example_en: She added a special spice to the soup to make it tasty.
example_uz: U sho'rvani mazali qilish uchun maxsus ziravor qo'shdi.

definition_en: Having the shape of an egg or an elongated circle.
example_en: The artist drew an oval shape on the piece of paper.
example_uz: Rassom qog'oz varag'iga tuxumsimon shakl chizdi.

definition_en: To express something indirectly without saying it clearly in words.
example_en: His silence implies that he does not agree with the plan.
example_uz: Uning sukuti rejaga rozi emasligini anglatadi.

definition_en: The physical body of an animal or human, excluding internal cells.
example_en: The study focused on the development of the soma in early stages.
example_uz: Tadqiqot dastlabki bosqichlarda tananing rivojlanishiga qaratilgan.

definition_en: An insulated box used to keep food and drinks cold while traveling.
example_en: We kept our drinks in a cooler during the long summer trip.
example_uz: Yozgi uzoq safar davomida ichimliklarimizni sovutkich qutida saqladik.

definition_en: A professional opinion about how much something is worth or how well someone is performing.
example_en: The manager gave me a fair appraisal of my work this year.
example_uz: Menejer yil davomida qilgan ishimga adolatli baho berdi.

definition_en: Connected with the sea, ships, or navigation.
example_en: The country has a long history of maritime trade and exploration.
example_uz: Bu mamlakat uzoq tarixga ega dengiz savdosi va kashfiyotlari bilan mashhur.

definition_en: Giving a document or proposal to someone so they can consider it or approve it.
example_en: I am submitting my final project report to the professor today.
example_uz: Men bugun professorga yakuniy loyiha hisobotimni topshiryapman.

definition_en: Located above the level of your head; up in the sky or ceiling.
example_en: You should store your bag in the overhead locker during the flight.
example_uz: Parvoz paytida sumkangizni tepadagi javonga joylashtirishingiz kerak.

definition_en: A standard code used for representing text in computers and other devices.
example_en: The file was saved in plain ASCII text format for better compatibility.
example_uz: Fayl yaxshiroq moslashuvchanlik uchun oddiy ASCII matn formatida saqlandi.

definition_en: A quantity of goods that is sent to a place by ship, truck, or plane.
example_en: We are expecting a new shipment of products to arrive on Monday.
example_uz: Dushanba kuni mahsulotlarning yangi jo‘natmasi kelishini kutyapmiz.

definition_en: Relating to the physical features, layout, or location of an area.
example_en: There are many geographical differences between the two regions of the country.
example_uz: Mamlakatning bu ikki hududi o‘rtasida ko‘plab geografik farqlar mavjud.

definition_en: A person who gives money, organs, or blood to help others.
example_en: The charity hospital relies on funding from a generous anonymous donor.
example_uz: Xayriya shifoxonasi saxovatpesha noma’lum homiy tomonidan ajratilgan mablag‘ga tayanadi.

definition_en: A state of worry, nervousness or serious disagreement between people or groups.
example_en: The tension between the two countries has increased over the last week.
example_uz: Oxirgi haftada ikki mamlakat oʻrtasidagi ziddiyat yanada kuchaydi.

definition_en: Things that are unwanted or of no use and should be thrown away.
example_en: Please take out the trash before you leave the house tonight.
example_uz: Uyga ketishdan oldin iltimos axlatni tashlab yuboring.

definition_en: One of several levels or layers in a structure or organization.
example_en: The stadium was built with a second tier to hold more fans.
example_uz: Stadion koʻproq muxlis sigʻishi uchun ikkinchi qavat bilan kengaytirildi.

definition_en: A British nobleman who holds a high rank, above a viscount and below a marquess.
example_en: The earl invited several guests to his private estate for the weekend.
example_uz: Graf dam olish kunlari o'z mulkiga bir nechta mehmonni taklif qildi.

definition_en: A large country house with the land that belongs to it.
example_en: They walked through the beautiful gardens surrounding the old stone manor.
example_uz: Ular qadimiy tosh qarorgohni o'rab turgan go'zal bog'lar bo'ylab sayr qilishdi.

definition_en: A flat paper container used for sending letters or documents by mail.
example_en: I put the letter into an envelope and wrote the address clearly.
example_uz: Men xatni konvertga soldim va manzilni aniq qilib yozib qo'ydim.

definition_en: The country where a person was born or where they feel they belong.
example_en: After many years abroad, he decided to return to his homeland.
example_uz: Ko'p yillar xorijda yashagach, u o'z vataniga qaytishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: A place or party where people go to dance to recorded pop music.
example_en: They went to a local disco to dance with their friends tonight.
example_uz: Ular bugun oqshom do'stlari bilan raqsga tushish uchun mahalliy diskotekaga borishdi.

definition_en: The open area enclosed within the outer defensive walls of a castle or fortress.
example_en: The soldiers gathered in the castle bailey to prepare for the defense.
example_uz: Askarlar qal’ani himoya qilishga tayyorgarlik ko‘rish uchun hovliga yig‘ilishdi.

definition_en: A command in computer programming that marks the end of a conditional if statement.
example_en: You must include the endif statement to close the block of code correctly.
example_uz: Kod blokini to‘g‘ri yopish uchun endif buyrug‘ini qo‘shishingiz kerak.

definition_en: Strong feelings such as joy, sadness, anger, or love experienced by a person.
example_en: It is healthy to express your emotions instead of keeping them inside.
example_uz: Hissiyotlaringizni ichingizda saqlagandan ko‘ra ularni ifodalash sog‘lomroqdir.

definition_en: A tall waterproof rubber boot worn to keep feet dry in wet, muddy weather.
example_en: She put on her wellingtons before walking through the muddy forest paths.
example_uz: Loyli o‘rmon yo‘llaridan yurishdan oldin u rezina etiklarini kiyib oldi.

definition_en: Something that has no end and will last for all time.
example_en: The stars seemed to shine with an eternal light in the sky.
example_uz: Yulduzlar osmonda xuddi abadiy nur sochayotgandek tuyuldi.

definition_en: Relating to the people or things that have existed in a place from the beginning.
example_en: The museum displays many artifacts from the country's aboriginal people.
example_uz: Muzeyda mamlakatning tub aholisiga tegishli ko'plab buyumlar namoyish etilgan.

definition_en: Very unusual or special in a way that makes people notice it.
example_en: She made a remarkable recovery after being very ill for two weeks.
example_uz: U ikki hafta juda qattiq kasal bo'lgandan keyin ajoyib tarzda tuzalib ketdi.

definition_en: The action of turning around a central point or an axis.
example_en: The Earth's rotation causes the change between day and night.
example_uz: Yerdagi kun va tun almashinuvi uning o'z o'qi atrofida aylanishi tufayli sodir bo'ladi.

definition_en: Doing or achieving a lot of work or good results.
example_en: We had a very productive meeting and solved most of our problems.
example_uz: Biz juda samarali yig'ilish o'tkazdik va muammolarimizning aksariyatini hal qildik.

definition_en: A wide city street, often with trees planted along the sides.
example_en: We live on a beautiful tree-lined boulevard in the city center.
example_uz: Biz shaharning qoq markazidagi manzarali shohko'chada yashaymiz.

definition_en: A farm animal with a pinkish body, used for its meat.
example_en: The farmer feeds his pigs early every morning on the farm.
example_uz: Fermer har kuni ertalab fermadagi cho'chqalarini boqadi.

definition_en: A standard or set of numbers used to measure or evaluate something.
example_en: They use specific business metrics to track their monthly company growth.
example_uz: Ular kompaniyaning oylik o'sishini kuzatish uchun maxsus biznes ko'rsatkichlaridan foydalanadilar.

definition_en: Following rules or doing what is expected by others without complaining.
example_en: The company must be compliant with the new environmental safety regulations.
example_uz: Kompaniya yangi ekologik xavfsizlik qoidalariga rioya qilishi shart.

definition_en: Reduced by a certain amount; without something.
example_en: Ten minus four equals six in this simple math problem.
example_uz: Bu oddiy misolda o'n ayirilgan to'rt oltiga teng.

definition_en: Punishments or fines imposed for breaking a rule or law.
example_en: There are severe penalties for companies that ignore the new regulations.
example_uz: Yangi qoidalarga e'tibor bermaydigan kompaniyalar uchun qattiq jarimalar mavjud.

definition_en: The ability to form new ideas or mental images of things not present.
example_en: Children often use their imagination to create wonderful stories and games.
example_uz: Bolalar ajoyib hikoyalar va o'yinlar o'ylab topish uchun tez-tez xayol kuchidan foydalanadilar.

definition_en: Made something start working or become active.
example_en: She activated the security alarm as soon as she entered the house.
example_uz: U uyga kirishi bilan xavfsizlik signalizatsiyasini ishga tushirdi.

definition_en: A woman who performs in plays, movies, or television shows.
example_en: The famous actress won an award for her role in the film.
example_uz: Mashhur aktrisa filmdagi roli uchun mukofotni qo'lga kiritdi.

definition_en: A dirty or untidy state of things that is unpleasant or confusing.
example_en: Your bedroom is such a mess that I cannot find my socks.
example_uz: Yotoqxonang shunchalik tartibsizki paypoqlarimni topa olmayapman.

definition_en: People who are professionally involved in politics or hold a government office.
example_en: Politicians should work hard to improve the lives of all citizens.
example_uz: Siyosatchilar barcha fuqarolarning hayotini yaxshilash uchun qattiq ishlashlari kerak.

definition_en: Provided with light so that things can be clearly seen.
example_en: He walked down the brightly lit corridor to reach the main hall.
example_uz: U asosiy zalga yetib borish uchun yorug' yoritilgan yo'lakdan yurdi.

definition_en: A natural light display in the Earth's sky, seen mainly in high-latitude regions.
example_en: We traveled north specifically to watch the beautiful aurora in the sky.
example_uz: Biz osmondagi go'zal qutb yog'dusini tomosha qilish uchun maxsus shimolga bordik.

definition_en: The first public performance of a movie, play, or show.
example_en: The director attended the red carpet premiere of his latest action movie.
example_uz: Rejissyor o'zining eng yangi jangari filmi premyerasida qizil yo'lakda ishtirok etdi.

definition_en: A person or organization, like a bank, that allows you to borrow money.
example_en: The lender required a signature before approving the loan for my business.
example_uz: Kredit beruvchi biznesim uchun qarzni ma'qullashdan oldin imzoyimni talab qildi.

definition_en: An area that is dark because something is blocking direct sunlight.
example_en: The old oak tree gave shade in the heat of the day.
example_uz: Kun qiziganda qari eman daraxti soya berib turdi.

definition_en: A large group of people who sing together in a performance.
example_en: The school chorus performed beautifully at the annual winter concert.
example_uz: Maktab xori yillik qishki konsertda juda chiroyli kuyladi.

definition_en: A regular and repeated pattern of sounds or movements.
example_en: Once you get the rhythm of it, the job will become easy.
example_uz: Bir marta maromini tushunib olsangiz, ish juda osonlashadi.

definition_en: Any of the numbers from 0 to 9.
example_en: The passcode consists of four digits that are easy to remember.
example_uz: Parol eslab qolish oson bo'lgan to'rtta raqamdan iborat.

definition_en: Relating to the food that a person or animal eats regularly.
example_en: If you have any dietary requirements, please inform the kitchen staff.
example_uz: Agar parhezingiz bilan bog'liq maxsus talablar bo'lsa, oshxona xodimlariga ayting.

definition_en: A long and complex piece of music written for an orchestra.
example_en: The orchestra played a famous symphony by Beethoven at the gala.
example_uz: Galada orkestr Betxovenning mashhur simfoniyasini ijro etdi.

definition_en: Happening or done very quickly and without warning.
example_en: The sudden change in the weather caught us all by surprise.
example_uz: Ob-havoning kutilmagan o'zgarishi barchamizni hayron qoldirdi.

definition_en: Water that falls from the sky to the ground as rain, snow, or hail.
example_en: The region receives very little precipitation throughout the entire year.
example_uz: Bu hududga yil davomida juda kam yog'in tushadi.

definition_en: The words of a song or a poem expressing personal thoughts and feelings.
example_en: I really love the lyrics of this song, they are so emotional.
example_uz: Menga bu qo'shiqning matni juda yoqadi, u juda ta'sirli.

definition_en: The state of being alone and separated from other people or things.
example_en: She lived her final year in complete isolation, not wanting to see anybody.
example_uz: U oxirgi yilini hech kimni ko'rishni istamay butunlay yolg'izlikda o'tkazdi.

definition_en: Nearly correct or accurate, but not completely exact.
example_en: Can you give me an approximate cost for fixing the broken car?
example_uz: Buzilgan mashinani tuzatish uchun taxminiy narxni ayta olasizmi?

definition_en: A long, thick piece of string made of twisted threads used for tying things.
example_en: The sailors used a thick rope to tie the boat to land.
example_uz: Dengizchilar qayiqni qirg'oqqa bog'lash uchun yo'g'on arqondan foydalanishdi.

definition_en: A person whose job is to write computer programs.
example_en: My brother works as a programmer at a large software company.
example_uz: Akam yirik dasturiy ta'minot kompaniyasida dasturchi bo'lib ishlaydi.

definition_en: A place where people take their unwanted waste and leave it.
example_en: We drove to the local dump to throw away our old furniture.
example_uz: Eski mebellarimizni tashlab yuborish uchun mahalliy axlatxonaga bordik.

definition_en: Not having all the parts that are needed; not finished.
example_en: The report was incomplete because he forgot to add the final numbers.
example_uz: Hisobot chala edi, chunki u oxirgi raqamlarni qo'shishni unutib qo'ydi.

definition_en: A book or record that describes past events in the order they happened.
example_en: The book is a detailed chronicle of the city's early development.
example_uz: Bu kitob shaharning ilk rivojlanish davri haqidagi batafsil yilnomadir.

definition_en: A structure that shoots water into the air in a garden or public place.
example_en: His house is right beside that fountain on Street 15.
example_uz: Uning uyi 15-ko'chadagi o'sha favvora yonida joylashgan.

definition_en: Someone who is slightly overweight and has a rounded, soft appearance.
example_en: It’s quite normal for healthy babies to have chubby cheeks.
example_uz: Sog'lom chaqaloqlarning yonoqlari to'lachadan kelgan bo'lishi tabiiy hol.

definition_en: Very serious and worrying in a way that suggests potential danger or disaster.
example_en: The situation is grave, and we must act very quickly now.
example_uz: Vaziyat juda jiddiy va biz hozir zudlik bilan harakat qilishimiz kerak.

definition_en: Books that tell the true story of a person's life.
example_en: She enjoys reading biographies of famous people from the past.
example_uz: U o'tmishdagi mashhur insonlarning tarjimayi hollarini o'qishni yoqtiradi.

definition_en: A cheap mobile phone bought for short-term use and then discarded.
example_en: The spy used a burner phone so he could not be tracked.
example_uz: Josus kuzatilmasligi uchun bir marta ishlatiladigan telefondan foydalandi.

definition_en: A person whose job is to examine facts to find the truth about something.
example_en: The lead investigator examined all the evidence found at the crime scene.
example_uz: Bosh tergovchi jinoyat joyidan topilgan barcha dalillarni ko‘zdan kechirdi.

definition_en: A person who brings a legal case against someone else in a court of law.
example_en: The plaintiff asked the judge for financial compensation for their damaged property.
example_uz: Da’vogar sudyadan yetkazilgan zarar uchun tovon puli to‘lab berishni so‘radi.

definition_en: Kind, calm, and careful not to hurt anyone or anything.
example_en: She gave the baby a gentle touch on the cheek to wake him.
example_uz: U go‘dakni uyg‘otish uchun yuzini muloyimlik bilan siladi.

definition_en: People who are kept in a prison as a punishment for a crime.
example_en: The prison guards watched over the prisoners throughout the long cold night.
example_uz: Qamoqxona qo‘riqchilari tun bo‘yi mahbuslarni kuzatib chiqishdi.

definition_en: Extending further down from the top or surface than something else.

example_uz: Suv topish uchun yerni chuqurroq qazishimizga to‘g‘ri keldi.

definition_en: A flexible pipe used to carry water to flowers or put out fires.
example_en: Use the garden hose to wash the dirt off your car wheels.
example_uz: Mashinangiz g‘ildiraklaridagi loyni yuvish uchun bog‘ shlangidan foydalaning.

definition_en: Relating to the sea between Europe, Africa, and Asia or the countries around it.
example_en: The Mediterranean diet is famous for being healthy and rich in vegetables.
example_uz: O'rta yer dengizi parhezi sog'lom va sabzavotlarga boy ekanligi bilan mashhur.

definition_en: Social and entertainment activities that happen in the evening and at night.
example_en: Rio de Janeiro boasts the best nightlife in South America.
example_uz: Rio-de-Janeyro Janubiy Amerikadagi eng yaxshi tungi hayoti bilan ajralib turadi.

definition_en: A length of film or video that has been recorded.
example_en: The footage we shot at the event yesterday was very clear.
example_uz: Kecha tadbirda yozib olgan video lavhamiz juda tiniq chiqdi.

definition_en: Deserving of respect, attention, or a particular reward.
example_en: She is a worthy winner of this prestigious international award.
example_uz: U ushbu nufuzli xalqaro mukofotning munosib g'olibidir.

definition_en: A pair of two people who work or perform together.
example_en: The famous musical duo played their best songs at the concert.
example_uz: Mashhur musiqiy juftlik konsertda o'zlarining eng yaxshi qo'shiqlarini ijro etishdi.

definition_en: Much more than is necessary, normal, or reasonable.
example_en: The movie's excessive use of special effects distracted from the plot.
example_uz: Filmda maxsus effektlarning haddan tashqari ko'pligi syujetdan chalg'itib qo'ydi.

definition_en: A program that shows moving images on a screen when it is not being used.
example_en: I configured my screensaver to appear after only two minutes of inactivity.
example_uz: Men ekran himoyachisini ikki daqiqa harakatsizlikdan so'ng chiqadigan qilib sozladim.

definition_en: The act of deciding how much money something is worth.
example_en: The bank requested a professional valuation of the house before approving the loan.
example_uz: Bank kreditni tasdiqlashdan oldin uyni professional tarzda baholashni talab qildi.

definition_en: Surprising because you did not think that it would happen.
example_en: We had an unexpected visitor at the house late last night.
example_uz: Kecha tunda uyimizga kutilmagan mehmon tashrif buyurdi.

definition_en: A thin cylinder of tobacco rolled in paper for smoking.
example_en: He decided to quit smoking and threw away his last cigarette.
example_uz: U chekishni tashlashga qaror qildi va oxirgi sigaretini tashlab yubordi.

definition_en: A thick cloud near the ground that makes it difficult to see.
example_en: It was difficult to drive home because of the thick morning fog.
example_uz: Qalin ertalabki tuman tufayli uyga mashinada qaytish qiyin bo'ldi.

definition_en: A special quality or feature that makes a person or thing easy to recognize.
example_en: A key characteristic of this bird is its bright yellow beak.
example_uz: Bu qushning asosiy xususiyati uning yorqin sariq tumshugʻidir.

definition_en: A large open area just inside the main entrance of a building like a hotel.
example_en: I waited in the hotel lobby for my friends to arrive.
example_uz: Doʻstlarim kelguncha mehmonxona foyesida kutib turdim.

definition_en: As a result of a particular action or situation.
example_en: It rained heavily and, consequently, the football match was cancelled.
example_uz: Kuchli yomgʻir yogʻdi va shu sababli futbol oʻyini bekor qilindi.

definition_en: The title of a newspaper article, printed in large letters at the top.
example_en: The headline of the morning newspaper was about the new government plan.
example_uz: Ertalabki gazeta sarlavhasi hukumatning yangi rejasi haqida edi.

definition_en: To hit someone or something hard with a closed hand.
example_en: If she punches me, I am going to be very angry.
example_uz: Agar u meni mushtlasa, juda jahlim chiqadi.

definition_en: A casual way of saying that you must or need to do something.
example_en: I gotta learn these new English words for my exam.
example_uz: Imtihon uchun mana bu yangi inglizcha so‘zlarni yodlashim kerak.

definition_en: A man who works on a ranch looking after horses and cows.
example_en: The cowboy spent his entire day riding across the large farm.
example_uz: Kovboy butun kunini katta fermada otdan tushmay o‘tkazdi.

definition_en: A written or spoken account of events that happened in a story.
example_en: The author wrote a fascinating narrative about his travels in Asia.
example_uz: Muallif o‘zining Osiyo bo‘ylab sayohatlari haqida qiziqarli hikoya yozdi.

definition_en: The belief that your actions cause good or bad things to happen to you.
example_en: She believes in karma and always tries to be kind to everyone.
example_uz: U karmaga ishonadi va har doim hammaga yaxshilik qilishga harakat qiladi.

definition_en: Relating to information that can be measured or counted rather than just described.
example_en: The researchers conducted a quantitative analysis of the collected survey data.
example_uz: Tadqiqotchilar to'plangan so'rovnoma ma'lumotlarini miqdoriy tahlil qilishdi.

definition_en: A part of something that has already been divided into smaller sections.
example_en: The main department was further organized into several smaller subdivisions.
example_uz: Asosiy bo'lim keyinchalik bir nechta kichik qismlarga ajratildi.

definition_en: To win a victory over someone in a battle, game, or competition.
example_en: Our team managed to defeat the current champions in the final match.
example_uz: Jamoamiz final o'yinida amaldagi chempionlarni yengishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.

definition_en: A clear difference or contrast between two similar people or things.
example_en: There is a sharp distinction between healthy debate and angry arguments.
example_uz: Sog'lom munozara bilan janjalli tortishuvlar o'rtasida katta farq bor.

definition_en: Used to describe a child who behaves badly or does not obey rules.
example_en: The naughty child was sent to his room for misbehaving at dinner.
example_uz: Sho'x bola kechki ovqat paytida yomon xulqi uchun xonasiga yuborildi.

definition_en: Protected against loss or damage by an insurance policy.
example_en: All your expensive equipment should be fully insured against theft or damage.
example_uz: Barcha qimmatbaho jihozlaringiz o'g'rilik yoki shikastlanishdan to'liq sug'urtalangan bo'lishi kerak.

definition_en: A person who plays the harp as a musical instrument.
example_en: The harper performed a beautiful melody at the king's traditional wedding feast.
example_uz: Arfechi qirolning an'anaviy to'y ziyofatida go'zal kuyni ijro etdi.

definition_en: Special permission to not do something or not pay something that others must do.
example_en: Students can apply for an exemption from taking the final exam.
example_uz: Talabalar yakuniy imtihondan ozod bo'lish uchun ariza topshirishlari mumkin.

definition_en: The ability to continue a process or activity without causing damage to the environment.
example_en: Many companies are now focusing on environmental sustainability in their production.
example_uz: Ko'pgina kompaniyalar hozirda ishlab chiqarishda ekologik barqarorlikka e'tibor qaratmoqda.

definition_en: A permanent picture or pattern made on the skin using ink and needles.
example_en: He has a small tattoo of a bird on his arm.
example_uz: Uning qo'lida qush tasviri tushirilgan kichik tatuirovka bor.

definition_en: To move something quickly up and down or from side to side.
example_en: Please shake the bottle well before you pour the juice.
example_uz: Iltimos, sharbatni quyishdan oldin idishni yaxshilab silkitib oling.

definition_en: A type of mathematics that uses letters to represent unknown numbers in equations.
example_en: I found algebra very difficult to understand when I was at school.
example_uz: Maktabda o'qib yurganimda algebra menga juda qiyin tuyulardi.

definition_en: A small evergreen tree with prickly leaves and red berries, often used at Christmas.
example_en: We decorated the front door with a wreath made of holly.
example_uz: Biz kirish eshigini g'urrakdan yasalgan gulchambar bilan bezatdik.

definition_en: The way in which text or data is arranged on a page or screen.
example_en: The formatting of your document looks very professional and clean.
example_uz: Hujjatlaringizning formatlanishi juda professional va tartibli ko'rinadi.

definition_en: Showing a lack of good sense or appearing foolish in a funny way.
example_en: They were all laughing because he told a very silly joke.
example_uz: U juda ahmoqona hazil aytgani uchun hamma kulardi.

definition_en: Relating to the process of providing or obtaining the food necessary for health.
example_en: Check the label for the nutritional information before you buy this snack.
example_uz: Bu gazakni sotib olishdan oldin uning ozuqaviy qiymatini o‘qib chiqing.

definition_en: Kind treatment towards someone who has the power to harm or punish you.
example_en: The judge showed mercy by giving the man a lighter sentence.
example_uz: Sudya kishiga yengilroq jazo tayinlab, rahm-shafqat ko‘rsatdi.

definition_en: Without restriction or interference from anyone else.
example_en: In this classroom, students are encouraged to express their thoughts freely.
example_uz: Bu sinfxonada o‘quvchilarga o‘z fikrlarini erkin ifodalash tavsiya etiladi.

definition_en: The time of day when the sun first appears in the morning sky.
example_en: We woke up early to watch the beautiful sunrise over the mountains.
example_uz: Tog‘lar uzra quyosh chiqishini tomosha qilish uchun erta uyg‘ondik.

definition_en: Paper or other material used to cover an object to protect or decorate it.
example_en: She carefully removed the shiny gold wrapping from the birthday present.
example_uz: U tug'ilgan kun sovg'asining yaltiroq tillarang qog'ozini ehtiyotkorlik bilan oldi.

definition_en: The thick soft hair that covers the bodies of some animals.
example_en: The cat has very soft, thick fur that keeps it warm outside.
example_uz: Mushukning tashqarida isib turishiga yordam beradigan juda yumshoq va qalin juni bor.

definition_en: A plan showing when events will happen or have happened in order.
example_en: The manager created a timeline for completing the project by next month.
example_uz: Menejer loyihani kelasi oyga qadar tugatish uchun vaqt jadvalini ishlab chiqdi.

definition_en: A thick, black, sticky substance used for making roads or roofs.
example_en: Workers were busy pouring hot tar onto the new road surface.
example_uz: Ishchilar yangi yo'l yuzasiga qaynayotgan qora smolani quyish bilan band edilar.

definition_en: Happening quickly and easily without any waiting or problems.
example_en: The company readily accepted our suggestions for improving the work process.
example_uz: Kompaniya ish jarayonini yaxshilash bo'yicha takliflarimizni jon deb qabul qildi.

definition_en: A connection with a larger group or organization.
example_en: His political affiliation with the party helped him find many new friends.
example_uz: Uning partiya bilan siyosiy aloqasi ko'plab yangi do'stlar orttirishiga yordam berdi.

definition_en: A structure made of wood or metal that separates two pieces of land.
example_en: We decided to build a wooden fence around our backyard garden.
example_uz: Biz hovlimiz atrofini yog‘och panjara bilan o‘rashga qaror qildik.

definition_en: A person who prefers not to wear any clothes in public places.
example_en: The nudist spent his entire summer holiday at a private beach.
example_uz: U yalang‘och kishilar uchun ajratilgan xususiy sohil bo‘yida butun yozgi ta’tilini o‘tkazdi.

definition_en: Having no limits or end; impossible to measure or count.
example_en: The universe seems to be infinite in its scale and complexity.
example_uz: Koinot o‘zining ko‘lami va murakkabligi jihatidan cheksizdek ko‘rinadi.

definition_en: A large group of families who are all related to the same ancestor.
example_en: Members of the clan gathered annually to celebrate their shared heritage.
example_uz: Urug‘ a’zolari o‘zlarining umumiy merosini nishonlash uchun har yili yig‘ilishardi.

definition_en: In a way that is allowed by the rules or the law.
example_en: You are legally required to show your passport at the border.
example_uz: Chegarada pasportingizni ko‘rsatishingiz qonunan talab qilinadi.

definition_en: An uncomfortable feeling when you have done something wrong or embarrassing.
example_en: He felt great shame after telling a lie to his best friend.
example_uz: Eng yaqin do‘stiga yolg‘on gapirganidan keyin u qattiq uyaldi.

definition_en: Good enough to meet a need or requirement.
example_en: The satisfactory results of the survey led to his promotion.
example_uz: So'rovnomaning qoniqarli natijalari uning lavozimi ko'tarilishiga sabab bo'ldi.

definition_en: Involving or causing a complete or dramatic change.
example_en: The company introduced a revolutionary new tool for data analysis.
example_uz: Kompaniya ma'lumotlarni tahlil qilish uchun inqilobiy yangi vositani taqdim etdi.

definition_en: To make things work at the same time or speed.
example_en: He synced his phone to the laptop to transfer data.
example_uz: U ma'lumotlarni ko'chirish uchun telefonini noutbuk bilan sinxronlashtirdi.

definition_en: A person who is not a member of the armed forces.
example_en: Three civilians were apprehended by the soldiers and taken away.
example_uz: Uch nafar tinch aholi vakili askarlar tomonidan qo'lga olinib, olib ketildi.

definition_en: The technology or system used for sending sounds over a distance.
example_en: The new mobile network uses advanced digital telephony standards.
example_uz: Yangi mobil tarmoq ilg'or raqamli telefoniya standartlaridan foydalanadi.

definition_en: A flat area of land that is higher than the surrounding land.
example_en: A few more miles brought us around a low mesa.
example_uz: Yana bir necha mil yo'l bosib, biz past yassi tog' atrofidan o'tdik.

definition_en: Causing or ending in death or serious destruction.
example_en: The car accident resulted in a fatal injury to the driver.
example_uz: Avtohalokat haydovchining o'limiga olib keladigan darajada jarohatlanishiga sabab bo'ldi.

definition_en: People whose job is to sell or rent houses and land.
example_en: The realtors helped us find a nice apartment in the city.
example_uz: Ko'chmas mulk agentlari shahardan yaxshi kvartira topishimizga yordam berishdi.

definition_en: The measurement of how thick an object is from one side to the other.
example_en: The wall has a thickness of thirty centimeters to keep us warm.
example_uz: Devorning qalinligi bizni issiq saqlash uchun o'ttiz santimetrni tashkil qiladi.

definition_en: Relating to visual images, charts, or drawings that are easy to understand.
example_en: Modern computer games feature very high quality graphical elements and animations.
example_uz: Zamonaviy kompyuter o'yinlari juda yuqori sifatli grafik elementlar va animatsiyalarga ega.

definition_en: A person with a very high level of intelligence or great natural ability.
example_en: Albert Einstein was a genius who changed our understanding of the universe.
example_uz: Albert Eynshteyn koinot haqidagi tushunchamizni o'zgartirgan daho bo'lgan.

definition_en: The industry that designs and builds aircraft, spacecraft, and satellites.
example_en: She works as an engineer in the growing aerospace industry in our city.
example_uz: U shahrimizdagi rivojlanib borayotgan aerokosmik sanoatida muhandis bo'lib ishlaydi.

definition_en: A person who fights in a war or a competitive sport.
example_en: The young fighter trained hard every day to win the championship belt.
example_uz: Yosh jangchi chempionlik kamarini yutish uchun har kuni qattiq shug'ullandi.

definition_en: Important, useful, or having a serious purpose.
example_en: We had a meaningful discussion about our future plans for the company.
example_uz: Biz kompaniya uchun kelajak rejalarimiz haqida mazmunli suhbat qurdik.

definition_en: The soft parts of the body, mainly muscle and fat, covering the bones.
example_en: The tiger has powerful muscles and flesh that allow it to hunt quickly.
example_uz: Yo'lbarsning kuchli mushaklari va eti unga tez ov qilish imkonini beradi.

definition_en: To move away from a place or situation, often because of danger or pressure.
example_en: The soldiers had to retreat when they realized the enemy was too strong.
example_uz: Dushman juda kuchli ekanini tushungan askarlar chekinishga majbur bo'ldi.

definition_en: Only just; by a very small amount or margin.
example_en: I was so tired that I could barely keep my eyes open.
example_uz: Shunchalik charchagan edimki, ko‘zlarimni zo‘rg‘a ochib turgandim.

definition_en: In or to any place; it does not matter where.
example_en: You can sit wherever you like in the empty theater.
example_uz: Bo‘sh teatrda qayerga xohlasangiz o‘sha yerga o‘tiravering.

definition_en: A small piece of thick fabric used to cover part of a floor.
example_en: She placed a soft rug in front of the warm fireplace.
example_uz: U issiq kamin oldiga yumshoq gilamcha to‘shadi.

definition_en: A person who believes in or supports the principles of democracy.
example_en: Every true democrat believes in the importance of fair and free elections.
example_uz: Har bir haqiqiy demokrat adolatli va erkin saylovlar muhimligiga ishonadi.

definition_en: A town or part of a large city that has its own local government.
example_en: He lives in a quiet borough on the outskirts of the city.
example_uz: U shaharning chekkasidagi sokin bir tumanda yashaydi.

definition_en: A path or route that is quicker than the normal way.
example_en: We know several shortcuts to get home before the traffic gets bad.
example_uz: Yo‘llarda tirbandlik boshlanmasidan oldin uyga yetib olish uchun bir nechta qisqa yo‘llarni bilamiz.

definition_en: A hard stone that is smooth and shiny when polished, used for building or art.
example_en: The floor of the grand hall was made of white marble.
example_uz: Katta zalning poydevori oq marmardan qilingan edi.

definition_en: To state clearly and exactly what is needed or required.
example_en: The contract specifies that the work must be finished by Friday.
example_uz: Shartnomada ish juma kunigacha tugatilishi kerakligi aniq belgilangan.

definition_en: The main body or frame of a ship or other large water vessel.
example_en: The ship suffered a large hole in its outer hull.
example_uz: Kemaning tashqi korpusida katta teshik paydo bo‘ldi.

definition_en: The official act of giving a school or organization formal approval to operate.
example_en: The university is seeking accreditation for its new engineering degree program.
example_uz: Universitet o‘zining yangi muhandislik yo‘nalishi uchun akkreditatsiyadan o‘tmoqchi.

definition_en: A small dark purple or black fruit that grows on a prickly bush.
example_en: We spent the whole afternoon picking blackberries in the wild forest.
example_uz: Biz butun tushdan keyin o‘rmonda yovvoyi maymunjon terib o‘tkazdik.

definition_en: An area of land that is high above the level of the sea.
example_en: Many rare flowers grow naturally in the highland regions of the country.
example_uz: Mamlakatning tog‘li hududlarida juda ko‘p noyob gullar o‘sadi.

definition_en: The practice of clearing your mind to feel calm and relaxed.
example_en: She practices daily meditation to help reduce her stress and anxiety.
example_uz: U stress va xavotirni kamaytirish uchun har kuni meditatsiya bilan shug‘ullanadi.

definition_en: Made of separate parts that can be joined together to build something.
example_en: The new kitchen is built using a flexible and efficient modular design.
example_uz: Yangi oshxona moslashuvchan va samarali modulli dizayn asosida qurilgan.

definition_en: A piece of equipment that records sound or makes it louder.
example_en: Please speak clearly into the microphone so everyone can hear you.
example_uz: Iltimos, hamma eshitishi uchun mikrofonga aniq gapiring.

definition_en: Being an important reason for something happening or being done.
example_en: She was instrumental in the success of the new company project.
example_uz: U kompaniyaning yangi loyihasi muvaffaqiyatida hal qiluvchi rol o'ynadi.

definition_en: To increase in size, quantity, or price very quickly.
example_en: Public debt will balloon if the government keeps spending so much.
example_uz: Agar hukumat xarajatni ko'paytiraversa, davlat qarzi keskin oshib ketadi.

definition_en: A short piece of writing sent to people in an organization.
example_en: The manager sent a memo about the upcoming office meeting.
example_uz: Menejer bo'lajak ofis yig'ilishi haqida eslatma yubordi.

definition_en: Meat from the leg of a pig, often prepared for eating.
example_en: We had some sandwiches made with fresh ham and lettuce.
example_uz: Biz yangi vetchina va salat bargidan sendvichlar tayyorladik.

definition_en: The regular rise and fall of the sea level caused by the moon.
example_en: The tide is coming in, so the beach is getting smaller.
example_uz: Suv sathi ko'tarilmoqda, shuning uchun sohil kichrayib boryapti.

definition_en: A list showing the positions of teams based on their points in a league.
example_en: I check the league standings every week to see my team's position.
example_uz: Jamoamning o‘rnini bilish uchun har hafta turnir jadvaliga qarab turaman.

definition_en: The act of dividing a country or an area into two or more parts.
example_en: The partition of the country caused many families to live far apart.
example_uz: Mamlakatning bo‘linishi ko‘plab oilalarning bir-biridan yiroqda yashashiga sabab bo‘ldi.

definition_en: Impossible to be seen by the human eye.
example_en: Some bacteria are invisible to the naked eye without a microscope.
example_uz: Ba'zi bakteriyalarni mikroskopsiz oddiy ko‘z bilan ko‘rib bo‘lmaydi.

definition_en: A style of dance music with a strong rhythm and a loud bass guitar.
example_en: We listened to some classic funk music at the party last night.
example_uz: Kecha bazmda klassik fank musiqalarini eshitib o‘tirdik.

definition_en: An object that can pull certain metals toward itself.
example_en: The magnet stuck firmly to the metal door of the fridge.
example_uz: Magnit muzlatgichning metall eshigiga mahkam yopishdi.

definition_en: A brand of high-performance and expensive luxury sports cars.
example_en: He saved all his money to buy a fast red Porsche.
example_uz: U tez yurar qizil Porshe sotib olish uchun barcha pulini tejab qo'ydi.

definition_en: A tropical reptile that looks like a small alligator.
example_en: The cayman waited patiently in the river for its next meal.
example_uz: Kayman daryoda o'z yemagini sabr bilan kutib turdi.

definition_en: A large, powerful wild cat with black spots that lives in the Americas.
example_en: The jaguar moved silently through the thick jungle grass.
example_uz: Yaguar qalin o'rmon o'tlarida jimjit harakatlanardi.

definition_en: To wind thread, string, or wire onto a spool or wheel.
example_en: The fisherman began to reel the heavy fish toward the boat.
example_uz: Baliqchi katta baliqni qayiqqa tomon tortib o'ray boshladi.

definition_en: Used to emphasize the total size, degree, or amount of something.
example_en: The success of the project was due to sheer hard work.
example_uz: Loyiha muvaffaqiyati faqatgina qilingan mehnat evaziga bo'ldi.

definition_en: Acting in a way that is not natural just to impress others.
example_en: He is just posing to look cool in front of his friends.
example_uz: U shunchaki do'stlari oldida zo'r ko'rinish uchun kibrlanib yuribdi.

definition_en: Units of length equal to one thousand meters.
example_en: We drove many kilometers to reach the beautiful mountain lake.
example_uz: Go'zal tog' ko'liga yetib borish uchun ko'p kilometr yo'l bosdik.

definition_en: A sign or piece of information that suggests something is true or may happen.
example_en: There is no indication that the fire was started by a person.
example_uz: Yong'in qasddan sodir etilganiga hech qanday belgi yo'q.

definition_en: A word used to tell someone that you are happy for their success or achievement.
example_en: Warm congratulations to you both on your wonderful wedding day!
example_uz: Sizlarni to'y kuningiz bilan chin qalbimdan tabriklayman!

definition_en: A very young dog.
example_en: We bought a small brown puppy from the animal shelter yesterday.
example_uz: Biz kecha hayvonlar boshpanasidan kichkina qo'ng'ir kuchukcha oldik.

definition_en: A unit of land area equal to about 4,000 square metres.
example_en: The farmer owns more than fifty acres of wheat fields nearby.
example_uz: Fermer yaqin atrofdagi ellik akrdan ortiq bug'doyzorga egalik qiladi.

definition_en: To be all around someone or something on every side.
example_en: The police decided to surround the building to catch the criminal.
example_uz: Politsiya jinoyatchini ushlash uchun binoni qurshab olishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: Action taken to hurt someone because they did something bad to you.
example_en: He wanted revenge after his colleague lied to get him fired.
example_uz: Hamkasbi uni ishdan bo'shatish uchun yolg'on gapirganidan keyin u o'ch olmoqchi bo'ldi.

definition_en: A business that provides expert advice to other companies or individuals.
example_en: They hired a top IT consultancy to improve their digital security systems.
example_uz: Ular raqamli xavfsizlik tizimlarini yaxshilash uchun nufuzli IT maslahat firmasini yollashdi.

definition_en: To walk or drive around an area regularly to keep it safe and secure.
example_en: The police officers patrol the city streets throughout the long night shift.
example_uz: Ichki ishlar xodimlari tunda shahar ko'chalarida patrullik qilishadi.

definition_en: To use your nose to notice a scent or to have a particular scent.
example_en: I can smell fresh coffee brewing in the kitchen early this morning.
example_uz: Ertalab oshxonadan yangi damlangan qahva hidi kelayotganini sezdim.

definition_en: An animal or insect that destroys crops or food or is very annoying.
example_en: Farmers use special methods to protect their crops from every common pest.
example_uz: Dehqonlar hosilini turli zararkunandalardan himoya qilish uchun maxsus usullardan foydalanadilar.

definition_en: A public festival with music, dancing, parades, and fun activities for people.
example_en: The whole town celebrates during the annual carnival with food and music.
example_uz: Butun shahar aholisi yillik sayil vaqtida musiqa va taomlar bilan bayram qilishadi.

definition_en: Used to show that a number or amount is not exact but close.
example_en: The journey to the capital city takes roughly three hours by train.
example_uz: Poytaxtga poyezdda borish taxminan uch soat vaqtni oladi.

definition_en: A small piece of paper or plastic with a sticky back that you can attach.
example_en: She decorated her laptop with a colorful sticker of a cute cat.
example_uz: U noutbugini mushuk rasmi tushirilgan rangli stiker bilan bezadi.

definition_en: A line of rocks, sand, or coral near the surface of the ocean.
example_en: The boat was damaged after hitting a hidden coral reef at night.
example_uz: Qayiq tunda ko'rinmas marjon rifiga urilib shikastlandi.

definition_en: In a way that relates to the body rather than the mind.
example_en: He feels physically exhausted after working in the garden all day long.
example_uz: U butun kun bog'da ishlagandan so'ng jismonan charchaganini his qildi.

definition_en: To separate something into two or more smaller parts.
example_en: We need to divide the housework equally between all the family members.
example_uz: Biz uy ishlarini barcha oila a'zolari o'rtasida teng taqsimlashimiz kerak.

definition_en: People or organizations with an interest or concern in a particular project.
example_en: The manager held a meeting to discuss the project with all stakeholders.
example_uz: Menejer loyihani barcha manfaatdor tomonlar bilan muhokama qilish uchun yig'ilish o'tkazdi.
